ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with high-intensity (white) mottling concentrated along distal margins; approximately 75% dark to 25% light pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white bands along the lower distal edges of both lobes; scattered circular white focal spots on the medial-right and distal-left regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression; approximate 130-degree vertex angle with moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; significant jagged peaks on the right lobe edge with vertical amplitudes exceeding 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing boundary transitioning to sharp upward and outward recurvature at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct circular and ring-like high-contrast pixel clusters on the right lobe surface; smaller high-intensity clusters on the upper-left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible against the dark central pigmentation, primarily in the lower-medial sector.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation and tissue loss on the upper-right trailing edge; prominent clusters of protruding calcified organisms (barnacles) on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical cluster of organisms extending beyond the anatomical boundary on the far-left fluke tip.
